svg.title: Monochromator — layer preview
svg.desc: Ivory is front silkscreen on a dark mask-colored presentation background. No decorative copper or separate LED is drawn. Common 52 x 44 mm canvas at original 1:1 scale. Footprint origin / illustrative LED center is SVG (50.816667,37.172857) mm. Full-card coordinates = SVG coordinates + (28.533333333,4) mm. Original card is 85.60 x 53.98 mm; SVG left edge is the phone boundary. Input rises 33.154536 degrees; selected output falls 33.154536 degrees. Native prism, ray centerlines, clear slit and 1.25 mm LED trim are preserved. Motto lettering is outlined; no installed fonts or embedded images are needed.
svg.metadata: Target layer: F.SilkS. KiCad footprint coordinates in mm: x = SVG x - 50.816666667; y = SVG y - 37.172857026. X increases right; Y increases down. Optics: business-card:Monochromator_60deg_NSF11_SilkScreen. Lettering: business-card:Monochromator_Motto_SilkScreen, at the same origin and 0 degree rotation. The background in the preview is presentation only; import the silkscreen file.
